entries.jp: {v:0050}この娘が能力を取り戻すような事があれば、{n}やっかいなのでな。{n}念のためだ！{p}{v:0051}死ね！
entries.en: {v:0050}It would be troublesome if this girl regained her{n}powers. I am merely taking precautions!{p}{v:0051}Die!

entries.jp: {v:002D}あんな奴に負けちゃダメよ！
entries.en: {v:002D}Don't you dare lose to a creep like that!

entries.jp: {v:002E}お前は創造主に逆らうというのか？{p}{v:002F}出来損ないがっ！
entries.en: {v:002E}You would defy your creator?{p}{v:002F}You defective wretch!

entries.jp: {v:0023}積年の想い、ようやく果たすときが来たぜ！
entries.en: {v:0023}I've waited years for this. Time to settle the score!

entries.jp: {v:0024}ルイセちゃんは絶対に守るんだから！
entries.en: {v:0024}I'm going to protect Luise-chan, no matter what!

entries.jp: {v:0025}お前がすべての元凶か‥‥。{FFF9}{FFFB}{n}{v:0026}ここで終わらせてみせる！
entries.en: {v:0025}So you are the source of all this...{FFF9}{FFFB}{v:0026}I will put an end to{n}it here!

entries.jp: {v:0027}彼女には指一本触れさせません！
entries.en: {v:0027}I will not let you lay a finger on her!

entries.jp: {v:0028}これ以上、お前の思い通りにはさせねぇぞ！
entries.en: {v:0028}You've had your way long enough, damn you!

entries.jp: {v:0029}バーンシュタイン国王の名にかけて、{n}人々を苦しめる存在は許せません！
entries.en: {v:0029}On my honor as King of Burnstein, I cannot tolerate{n}anyone who makes people suffer!

entries.jp: ‥‥{v:002A}なんと醜い‥‥。{p}{v:002B}この世から消し去ってくれる！
entries.en: ...{v:002A}How hideous...{p}{v:002B}I shall erase you from this world!

entries.jp: {v:002C}うるさい奴らめ。{n}邪魔をするな！
entries.en: {v:002C}You noisy pests. Stay out of my way!

entries.jp: ゼノス！{p}{FC02}実はゲヴェルがルイセちゃんを狙って‥‥！
わかった！{n}手助けするぜ！
entries.en: Got it! I'll give you a hand!

entries.jp: ‥‥{v:0036}はっはっはっはっ。{n}久しぶりだな。
entries.en: ...{v:0036}Ha ha ha ha. It has been a long time.

entries.jp: {v:0038}思い出したぞ。{n}今すべてをな‥‥。
{v:003A}おお、ウォレスか。{n}何をしている！{n}今はコイツを倒すことだけを考えろ！
entries.en: {v:003A}Oh, Wallace. What are you doing?! Focus on bringing this{n}thing down!
{v:003B}So it really is you, Captain Berger...

entries.jp: ‥‥{v:0041}心配をかけたようだな。{n}だが話はコイツを倒してからだ！
entries.en: ...{v:0041}It seems I've worried you. But we'll talk after we{n}defeat this thing!

entries.jp: {v:0043}もうどのくらい昔になるかな、{n}こうしてお前と戦ったのは。
entries.en: {v:0043}How long has it been since I last fought you like this?

entries.jp: {v:0044}生きていたとはな。{n}さすがと言おうか‥‥。
entries.en: {v:0044}So you survived. I suppose I should be impressed...

entries.jp: {v:0045}お前は我が部下を殺した。{n}その罪、命をもって償ってもらうぞ。
entries.en: {v:0045}You killed my men. You will pay for that with your life.

entries.jp: {v:0053}ええい、予想外の邪魔がはいったわ‥‥。{n}ここは一度‥‥。
entries.en: {v:0053}Curse this unforeseen interference... For now, I must...

entries.jp: {v:0046}これが２０年近くも剣を握ったことのない男の力か？{p}{v:0047}さすが我が私兵たちの元となっただけのことはある。
entries.en: {v:0046}Is this the strength of a man who has not held a{n}sword in nearly twenty years?{p}{v:0047}You were indeed a worthy model for my private army.

entries.jp: {v:004A}人の身でありながら我と対等に闘えた{n}貴様の力が惜しくてな。{n}その肉片を使わせてもらったわ！{p}{v:004B}いわばお前の分身が、我が手足となって{n}世界を混乱させていたのだ！
entries.en: {v:004A}Though human, you could fight me as an equal. I could{n}not bear to waste such strength, so I made use of a{n}piece of your flesh!{p}{v:004B}Your mirror images, so to speak, have served as my{n}hands and feet, throwing the world into chaos!
